articles.title: Labor Department Finalizes PBM Disclosure Rules for Self-Funded Plans
articles.summary: The Department of Labor has finalized new transparency rules requiring pharmacy benefit managers to disclose compensation and pricing details to self-funded employer health plans. This regulation empowers plan sponsors with greater visibility into PBM fees and pricing structures to fulfill their fiduciary duties under ERISA. The mandate increases accountability and changes how self-funded employers evaluate their pharmacy benefit contracts.
